dct_description_sm:
A geospatial line dataset representing the official 911 road centerline network for Prince Edward Island. 
This dataset includes all public and private roads used for emergency response routing, civic addressing, 
transportation planning, and mapping. Attributes typically include road name and road type used by the 
provincial 911 system.

Each row represents a single road segment within the provincial 911 road network.
